description: The service ceiling on the day: the book's service ceiling, a density altitude (where the best climb has fallen to 100 fpm, FAA-H-8083-25C ch. 11), found as an altitude in the forecast's temperatures (wingtip_flight::performance::altitude_at_density_altitude) to the nearest 100 ft; the book figure where the profile is empty.

book_ft.description: The profile's service ceiling, a standard day's.
